title: Senior Guidewire Developer (ClaimCenter Configuration)
description:
India \- Bangalore


Professional Services/Full time/Hybrid

  



Guidewire Professional Services partners with customers and systems integrators worldwide to implement and extend Guidewire’s cloud platform for P\&C insurers, reducing implementation effort and accelerating time\-to\-value. As a ClaimCenter Senior Consultant, you will work as part of our Global Delivery team, configuring and integrating ClaimCenter to help customers modernize their claims operations and adopt Guidewire Cloud.  

  

You will be an internal implementation and configuration specialist focused on ClaimCenter, collaborating closely with architects, business analysts, developers, and QA to deliver high\-quality solutions that balance out\-of\-the\-box capabilities with customer needs. This role is ideal for someone with 6 \- 9 years of experience who enjoys hands\-on configuration, integration, and data migration in an Agile, consulting style environment. At Guidewire, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI, encouraging you to leverage emerging technologies and data\-driven insights to enhance productivity and outcomes.


**Job Description**

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Configure Guidewire ClaimCenter (entities, workflows, rules, UI, product model) using recommended implementation patterns and out‑of‑the‑box capabilities wherever possible.
* Participate in requirement and design discussions with internal stakeholders (architects, BAs, developers, QA) to translate business and functional needs into ClaimCenter configuration and integration designs.
* Implement and support integrations between ClaimCenter and external/enterprise systems (policy, billing, document management, payments, third‑party services) using web services, REST APIs, messaging, and batch processes.
* Contribute to data migration activities including data mapping, transformation rules, migration scripts, test data preparation, and reconciliation/validation of migrated data.
* Develop and maintain functional and technical design documents, configuration workbooks, interface specifications, and deployment checklists to support repeatable delivery.
* Support system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT): clarify expected behavior, analyze defects, provide configuration fixes, and ensure quality prior to go‑live.
* Work within an Agile/Scrum delivery model, contributing to estimation, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos for your assigned workstreams.

Collaborate with global PS colleagues to* best practices, templates, and accelerators that improve quality and reduce implementation effort over time.
* Actively use Guidewire tools, automation, and responsible AI capabilities to increase your productivity and improve the quality and consistency of project outcomes.

**What you’ll bring**
---------------------

***Required:***

* 6 \- 9 years of overall IT experience, including hands\-on experience implementing or enhancing core insurance systems for P\&C insurers.
* Practical experience with Guidewire ClaimCenter (cloud or on‑premise) on at least one implementation or major enhancement, ideally in a configuration or integration\-focused role.
* Solid understanding of P\&C claims lifecycle and processes (FNOL, coverage verification, reserving, litigation, recoveries, subrogation, and closure).
* Experience with ClaimCenter configuration concepts such as data model, workflows, rules, exposure and claim segments, and user roles/permissions.
* Familiarity with common integration patterns and technologies (REST/SOAP web services, messaging, batch, file\-based interfaces) used in enterprise environments.
* Exposure to data migration activities (source‑to‑target mapping, data cleansing, test data setup, validation) for core system replacement or cloud transformation programs.
* Comfort working in Agile/Scrum teams and collaborating across global, cross‑functional stakeholders in a Professional Services or consulting context.
* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to break down complex requirements into clear, testable configuration and integration tasks.
* Demonstrated ability to embrace AI and data‑driven insights to drive innovation, productivity, and continuous improvement in your current role.
* Very good verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.

***Preferred:***
----------------

* Guidewire certification in ClaimCenter (e.g., ClaimCenter Specialist or Ace – ClaimCenter Configuration/Integration).
* Experience with other Guidewire InsuranceSuite applications (PolicyCenter, BillingCenter, ContactManager) or related integrations.
* Experience with cloud‑based implementations or modernization programs in P\&C insurance, ideally in a SaaS or multi‑tenant context.
* Prior experience working in a global Professional Services, consulting, or system integrator environment.

**Your Impact**


We believe in clarity and setting you up for success. In your first months, you will immerse yourself in an active BillingCenter implementation, take ownership of specific product configuration and integration workstreams, and lead technical design discussions with both Guidewire and customer teams to ensure solutions are aligned, scalable, and cloud\-ready. As you progress, you will help Professional Services advance its FY27 priorities by applying AI\-enabled methods, reusable accelerators, and automation to cut implementation effort and time, improve delivery quality, and support broader cloud and AI adoption across Guidewire’s customer base. Over time, your designs, code, and mentorship will shape how insurers run their businesses on our platform and how Guidewire fulfills its mission to transform the way the world’s P\&C insurers do business through digital, core, analytics, and AI innovation.


Interested in this position?

Guidewire is the platform P\&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540\+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.


As a partner to our customers, we continually evolve to enable their success. We are proud of our unparalleled implementation track record with 1600\+ successful projects, supported by the largest R\&D team and partner ecosystem in the industry. Working as part of a collaborative Agile engineering team, you will develop scalable software solutions using C\+\+, .NET/C\#, ASP.NET Core, Angular/React, and modern cloud technologies while partnering with Product Management, Solution Architects, Test Engineering, and Domain Experts to deliver secure, reliable, and high\-performance industrial software.

* Strong experience with Angular or React, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, NoSQL databases, object\-oriented programming, and enterprise software architecture.
